up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human target CHEMBL1255131 (Eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2 subunit 1). The target is defined as a human single-protein target. Required output columns: assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Filters: 1) Target CHEMBL ID must be CHEMBL12551. 2) Standard type must be IC50. 3) Standard relation must be exactly '='. 4) pChEMBL value must be non-null. 5) Organism must be human (tax_id 9606). Order results by molecule_chembl_id and then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT
    ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
    td.target_type,
    td.tax_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    a.molregno AS molecule_chembl_id,
    a.standard_type,
    a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1255131'
    AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
    AND td.tax_id = 9606
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    a.molregno,
    ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000
